objectives.label: Protect the Command Center
objectives.directive: Its destruction ends the mission in defeat.

objectives.label: Defeat the lone wolf
objectives.directive: Follow the southern path. One Trooper can defeat this wolf; Scouts cannot attack.

objectives.label: Clear the mountain den
objectives.directive: Collect the salvage beyond the lone wolf for two more Troopers. Cross the ridge south of the split summit, then follow the path south between the den teeth. Bring several Troopers to defeat four wolves and the larger alpha.

briefing.label: Materials economy
briefing.title: Clear the wolf threat
briefing.description: Defeat all six wolves to win. Victory unlocks free play.
briefing.goalsNote: Build income and an army. Defeat all six wolves to win.
briefing.rules: Paid construction · Timed production · Sell buildings for half their cost

goals.label: Build a Materials Refinery
goals.directive: Open Buildings and place a Refinery near your Command Center (100 Materials).

goals.label: Produce a Harvester
goals.directive: Select the Refinery, open Units, and produce a Harvester (50 Materials). Send it to Near Materials.

goals.label: Build a Field Barracks
goals.directive: Gather Materials, then build a Barracks within connected support coverage (100 Materials).

goals.label: Train Troopers
goals.directive: Select the Barracks to train Troopers (25 Materials). Use Attack Move to advance and fight.

popups.title: Welcome, Commander
popups.text: Open Buildings and place a Materials Refinery near your Command Center (100 Materials). Then select the Refinery and produce a Harvester from Units (50 Materials). Protect your Command Center while you build an army to clear the wolves.

popups.title: Support Network
popups.text: Place buildings inside the support radius of a completed, connected building. The network must reach your Command Center. A broken connection pauses construction, training, and cargo delivery until reconnected.

popups.title: Harvester Operations
popups.text: Select the Harvester, then click the blue Near Materials patch or choose Gather. It delivers cargo to its Refinery and repeats. When the patch runs out, send it to another patch. Gift boxes grant Materials when a unit walks over them.

popups.title: Barracks & Training
popups.text: Select the Barracks and choose a unit from Units. Troopers fight; Scouts see farther but cannot attack. Training runs one order at a time. Choose Rally Point, then click ground to send new units there. Cancel an order for a full refund.

popups.title: Scouting & Combat
popups.text: Select a unit, then click ground to move. Keep your unarmed Scout away from wolves. Drag a box around your Troopers, choose Attack Move, and click a destination. Follow the southern path to the lone wolf, then cross the ridge to the den.
